title: kate-ui: GPUI spike, read-only rendering of a Document with syntax colors, scroll benchmark
summary: The toolkit decision gate. Create crates/kate-ui on GPUI, open one window, render a kate-core Document read-only with themed spans, line numbers and smooth scrolling. Measure: open a 100,000-line file and scroll it; frame time must stay under 8 ms at 120 Hz on the owner's M-series machine, IME marked text must display, and Cmd-Q must quit cleanly. If GPUI fails any of these, this packet is rejected at Gate 3 and the fallback (objc2 + AppKit + Core Text) gets its own spike packet. kate-core is untouched either way.

lane.reason: Needs a Metal GPU, a display, macOS frameworks and a human watching the scroll. GPUI's build script needs Xcode tools, so cloud agents cannot even type-check this crate. Frame times are measured on the owner's machine because that is the machine the product targets.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate and the binary's first real main(). Dependencies with justification: gpui (Metal-backed UI with Core Text shaping, native macOS windows, menus and NSTextInputClient; the alternative is writing all of that against objc2), serde (telemetry output). gpui is a macOS-only dependency. On any other target, run() prints an error and exits. The Linux product-target exclude is a separate packet.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::visible_line_range_matches_viewport_and_scroll
regression_tests.asserts: Given viewport height, line height and Scroll { first_line }, the painted range is exactly the lines that intersect the viewport; no GPU needed for this test.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::shaped_line_cache_invalidates_on_revision_change
regression_tests.asserts: A cache entry for (line, revision) is a miss after the buffer revision changes and a hit otherwise.

regression_tests.name: spike::scroll_100k_lines_under_8ms
regression_tests.asserts: Manual, recorded in the PR as the KATEM5_PROFILE JSON lines from the owner's machine: p95 paint_micros < 8000 while scrolling a 100,000-line generated Rust file. The gatekeeper reads the numbers; the owner watches the screen. CI builds the crate but cannot run this.
